# ABSTRACT SECURITY
**The Security Data Pipeline Platform.** Send detection-ready data straight into Microsoft Sentinel — normalized, enriched, and cost-optimized.

[abstract.security](https://abstract.security) · [Documentation](https://docs.abstractsecurity.app/docs/integrations/destination-integrations/azure-sentinel-destination/) · [Book a demo](https://abstract.security)

---
### Azure Sentinel — Destination Integration
Abstract **writes to** Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. This deployment provisions the **full stack**: a Log Analytics workspace, **Microsoft Sentinel**, a Data Collection Endpoint, a custom `_CL` table, a Data Collection Rule, and the RBAC the Abstract service principal needs on the DCR.

✓ One-click full ingestion stack  ✓ Least-privilege DCR roles  ✓ Outputs the exact modal fields

⚠️ **Before you start:** create an Entra **app registration** (with a client secret) for Abstract and have its *service principal object ID* ready — ARM cannot create app registrations. The Client ID / Client Secret / Tenant ID are entered in Abstract, not here.

When the deployment finishes, the **Outputs** tab gives you the **Data Collection Rule ID**, **Data Collection Endpoint URL**, and **Log Stream Name** for the Abstract modal.

elements.name: mode
elements.label: Log Analytics workspace
elements.toolTip: Create a fresh workspace (and enable Sentinel on it), or target an existing workspace in THIS resource group.

allowedValues.label: Use an existing workspace (in this resource group)

elements.name: workspaceNameNew
elements.label: New workspace name (leave empty to auto-generate)

constraints.validationMessage: 4-63 chars, letters/numbers/hyphens, or empty to auto-generate.

elements.name: workspaceNameExisting
elements.label: Existing workspace name
elements.toolTip: The exact name of an existing Log Analytics workspace in this resource group.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the exact existing workspace name (4-63 chars).

elements.name: workspaceRetentionDays
elements.label: Workspace retention (days)
elements.toolTip: Applied when creating a new workspace.

elements.name: workspaceSku
elements.label: Workspace pricing tier
elements.toolTip: PerGB2018 is the recommended pay-as-you-go tier. Change advanced pricing options in the Bicep parameters if required.

elements.name: enableSentinel
elements.label: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on the new workspace

options.text: Make sure Microsoft Sentinel is already enabled on the existing workspace. This template does not change onboarding state for existing workspaces.

elements.name: existingWorkspaceLocation
elements.label: Existing workspace region
elements.toolTip: The Azure region of the existing workspace (e.g. eastus2). The DCE and DCR must be created in the SAME region as the workspace. Leave empty only if the workspace is in this deployment's region.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the workspace region as its short name (e.g. eastus, westeurope), or leave empty to use the deployment region.

options.text: Creates a Data Collection Endpoint, a custom *_CL table, and a Data Collection Rule that routes Abstract's stream into the table. The table has one column per top-level key of the Abstract Common Schema event, which is how the Abstract Azure Sentinel Destination sends it: nested objects are dynamic columns, and the rule's transformation sets TimeGenerated and stores the reserved id and type keys as acs_id and acs_type. Leave the columns field as [] unless you send a custom payload shape. The DCR stream name is 'Custom-<table name>' — enter that exact value as the 'Log Stream Name' in Abstract.

elements.name: customTableName
elements.label: Custom log table name
elements.toolTip: Must end in _CL. The Abstract 'Log Stream Name' will be Custom-<this value>.

constraints.validationMessage: Letters, numbers and underscores; must start with a letter and end with _CL (e.g. AbstractEventLogs_CL).
3-44 chars: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, periods.
3-64 chars: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, periods.

elements.name: tableColumnsJson
elements.label: Custom table columns (JSON; optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave [] to use the generated Abstract ACS schema. To override, enter a JSON array such as [{"name":"TimeGenerated","type":"datetime"},{"name":"Message","type":"string"}]. Include TimeGenerated with type datetime.

elements.name: customTablePlan
elements.label: Abstract table plan
elements.defaultValue: Keep current plan (Analytics for a new table)
elements.toolTip: Keep current plan leaves an existing table's plan alone, so a redeploy never changes its cost; a new table is created as Analytics. Analytics runs analytics rules and the Abstract content pack. Auxiliary is the Sentinel data lake tier: cheap long retention and KQL jobs, but no analytics rules or alerts. Basic sits between them. Choosing a plan for an existing table switches the whole table.

allowedValues.label: Keep current plan (Analytics for a new table)

elements.name: customTableRetentionDays
elements.label: Abstract table retention
elements.toolTip: Keep sends no retention: an existing table keeps its retention and a new table uses the workspace default, so a redeploy never deletes data. Choosing a value sets the table's total retention; a shorter value deletes older data.

options.text: ASIM tables are off by default. When on, every ASIM analytics rule, hunting query and workbook already running in this workspace also reads Abstract data: expect new alerts, duplicate events where Microsoft's own connector collects the same vendor, and a second billed copy of each mapped event. Turn it on in a staging workspace first, or one schema at a time. Details: solutions/docs/sentinel-destination-assurance.md in the Abstract-MS-Azure repository.

elements.name: enableAsim
elements.label: Also write Microsoft ASIM normalized tables (off by default)
elements.toolTip: Also writes each event into Microsoft's ASIM tables (ASimAuthenticationEventLogs and others), mapped from the Abstract schema. Microsoft's ASIM analytics rules, hunting queries and workbooks then work on Abstract data from every vendor. Needs Microsoft Sentinel on the workspace.

elements.name: asimSchemas
elements.label: ASIM schemas
elements.toolTip: The ASIM tables to write. Each maps from the Abstract schema, so it covers every vendor Abstract collects.

elements.name: enableDcrErrorLogs
elements.label: Log ingestion errors to the workspace (DCRLogErrors)
elements.toolTip: Records why Azure refused a request or dropped a row. Without it these failures show only as metric counts.

options.text: Abstract authenticates to Azure Monitor with an Entra app registration. ARM cannot create app registrations, so create the app + client secret first. Paste the app's SERVICE PRINCIPAL object ID below to have this template grant it Monitoring Metrics Publisher on the DCR (Monitoring Contributor only if you tick the box below). The Client ID, Client Secret and Tenant ID go into the Abstract modal directly.

elements.name: principalId
elements.label: Service principal object ID (for DCR role assignments)
elements.toolTip: Object ID of the Enterprise Application (service principal) for the Abstract app registration — NOT the Application (client) ID. Leave empty to assign the roles yourself later.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a GUID (the service principal OBJECT id) or empty.

elements.name: grantMonitoringContributor
elements.label: Also grant Monitoring Contributor on the DCR
elements.toolTip: Not needed to send data: the Logs Ingestion API needs only Monitoring Metrics Publisher, which is always granted. Monitoring Contributor would let a leaked Abstract credential rewrite or delete the DCR. Turn on only if your Abstract setup asks for it.
